meta.candidate_protocol: 30 titles per case, deterministic seed = sha256(case_id). Up to 8 judged-relevant (explicit) or 5 future-positive (broad) titles; up to 8 titles sharing the member's two most frequent recent coarse labels; rest sampled ~log(1+training interactions). Pool = titles with >=1 training-period interaction not already rated by the member before t.
meta.runtime_constraint: NOT APPLIED: no permitted runtime source in this build (MovieLens has none; TMDb not reachable). Runtime shown as unknown.
meta.showcase_rule: member excluded from FINAL aggregate if sha256('showcase:'+member) % 5 == 0

templates.text: a light, cozy mystery, not too intense
templates.notes: Mystery required. Grade 2 needs a light-tone signal (Comedy/Children/Animation/Romance genre or a light tag). Horror/Thriller/War or a dark/violent tag -> 0 even if Mystery. 'Cozy' is not a MovieLens genre; tone is a proxy.
Romance+Comedy = 2; Romance alone = 1. War/Horror or sad tags -> 0.
Sci-Fi required; grade 2 with Adventure genre or space tag.
'Real events' not verifiable beyond the Documentary genre.
